provenance: Adapted retained read-only mock/harness in a separate qa/backend directory. Includes exact current target-build ssd-picomem.c directly, with no source rewriting. sector_t is uint32_t; host unsigned/unsigned long width differs from16-bit ELKS. Port/IRQ/segmented-copy effects are modeled; no hardware or target timing claims.
limitations: Mock proves transaction sequence and polling bounds, not actual device removal, USB persistence or real IRQ timing.
Source-level no-retry latch does not repair inherited VFS buffered-write error reporting.
coverage: Read/write byte-exact success and LBA little-endian encoding
One516-byte write input phase; exact counts and no premature success
Wrong stages and both count bytes at applicable init/read/write handshakes
Bounded300000 polls for pending/wrong stage and completed-error clear timeout
Own completed status2/3 cleared once; preexisting status1/2/3/ff never reset
Read caller buffer unchanged on every read failure including final status failure after512 bytes
Failed read/write latch prevents subsequent port I/O and copies
Out-of-range capacity andUINT32_MAX rejected with zero port I/O or copies
